rows.title_full: AN ACT MANDATING ALL BARANGAYS TO CREATE A REGISTRY OF SKILLED WORKERS
rows.title_short: The Barangay Skilled Workers Registry Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to create a Barangay Skilled Workers Registry which shall serve as a repository of skilled workers´ information.
States that the Barangay Skilled Workers Registry shall contain information about skilled workers residing in its jurisdiction such as their names, addresses, contact information, skills or nature of services, and certifications, if any. Inclusion in the registry is purely voluntary and shall be free from any fee.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2022-11-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2022-11-16 and received by the Senate on 2022-11-16

rows.title_full: AN ACT INCREASING THE SERVICE INCENTIVE LEAVE OF EMPLOYEES, AMENDING FOR THE PURPOSE ARTICLE 95 OF PRESIDENTIAL DECREE NO. 442, AS AMENDED, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE LABOR CODE OF THE PHILIPPINES
rows.title_short: Increasing The Service Incentive Leave Of Employees, Amending For The Purpose Article 95 Of Presidential Decree No. 442, As Amended, Otherwise Known As The Labor Code Of The Philippines
rows.abstract:
Aims to grant private sector employees who have rendered at least one year of service an increase of yearly service incentive leave from five to ten days with pay.
Excludes those employees who are already enjoying the benefit herein provided, those enjoying vacation leave with pay of at least ten days and those employed in establishments regularly employing less than ten employees or in establishments exempted from granting this benefit by the Secretary of Labor after considering the viability or financial condition of such establishment.
